profile.name: Vishesh Pahuja
profile.program: TCHR5014 Professional Experience I, Southern Cross University
profile.intro: I teach in two hands-on subjects where students learn by making something real, a dish or a working program. This portfolio gathers what I have planned, taught and assessed on placement, and maps it against the Australian Professional Standards for Teachers at the Graduate career stage.
profile.about: I am completing my Victorian secondary placement at Mooroolbark College, teaching Food Technology and Digital Technologies. My work so far spans planning from the Victorian Curriculum, running a Year 7 assessment task from design through to marking and revision, and building differentiated resources for the full range of learners in a practical classroom.
profile.quote: Education is your ticket to adventure, a passport to freedom.

philosophy.heading: Teaching and learning through a cognitivist lens
philosophy.lead: Students build new understanding by connecting it to what they already hold. My practice is designed around how attention and memory actually work, and around who is in the room.

b: Learning is shaped by culture, language and background.
I start by finding out what students already know, then build from there.
New knowledge sticks when it connects to existing schemas.
Novice learners need explicit instruction; expert learners can work more independently.
Information moves from processing to long-term memory when load is managed.

pillars.t: A teaching framework I use every lesson
b: Gradual Release of Responsibility: I do, we do, you do.
Explicit teaching, modelled before it is expected.
Manage working memory by breaking learning into steps.
Scaffold heavily for novices, then withdraw the scaffold.
Culturally responsive teaching, informed by the 8 Ways of Aboriginal Learning.
Visualisation, modelling and watch-then-do as routes into a task.
The Alice Springs (Mparntwe) Education Declaration: excellence and equity.
Teacher responsibility as an ongoing professional obligation.

1.title: Know students and how they learn

focus.title: Development and characteristics of students
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of physical, social and intellectual development and characteristics of students and how these may affect learning.
focus.demo: I taught across Year 7 to Year 11 and pitched each task to the year level, from a Year 7 introduction to reading a recipe through to Year 10 design brief work.
focus.dev: Document how one student's developmental need changed a lesson I planned.

focus.title: Understand how students learn
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of research into how students learn and the implications for teaching.
focus.demo: My planning follows a cognitivist view of learning: practical work then theory, schemas built from prior knowledge, and cognitive load managed by breaking a task into steps.
focus.dev: Name the research behind a strategy in a lesson rationale.

focus.title: Diverse linguistic, cultural, religious and socioeconomic backgrounds
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge of teaching strategies that are responsive to the learning strengths and needs of students from diverse linguistic, cultural, religious and socioeconomic backgrounds.
focus.demo: I rewrote a Year 7 assessment rubric in three levels of language, keeping the meaning identical, so students building English and EAL/D students could read the same criteria.
focus.dev: Ask an EAL/D student whether the plain wording actually helped.

focus.title: Teaching Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students
focus.desc: Demonstrate broad knowledge and understanding of the impact of culture, cultural identity and linguistic background on the education of students from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.
focus.dev: Plan a genuine element using native foods, checked first with the school's Koorie support.

focus.title: Differentiate across the full range of abilities
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of strategies for differentiating teaching to meet the specific learning needs of students across the full range of abilities.

evidence.title: Tip posters placed around the room

focus.demo: One task reached the whole class: a scaffolded version for students who needed it, extension questions with sentence starters, and posters that let students move while they worked.
focus.dev: Build a lesson differentiated for a named range of abilities from the start.

focus.title: Full participation of students with disability
focus.desc: Demonstrate broad knowledge and understanding of legislative requirements and teaching strategies that support participation and learning of students with disability.
focus.dev: Record one adjustment I planned and the reason for it under the NCCD.

2.title: Know the content and how to teach it

focus.title: Content and teaching strategies of the teaching area
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the concepts, substance and structure of the content and teaching strategies of the teaching area.
focus.demo: I teach both of my areas: functional ingredients and food safety in Food Technology, and objects, attributes and methods in Python.
focus.dev: Add a second Digital Technologies artefact so the two areas are evenly evidenced.

focus.title: Content selection and organisation
focus.desc: Organise content into an effective learning and teaching sequence.

evidence.title: Cupcakes lesson: intentions, practical, exit ticket

focus.demo: I sequenced the lesson so the learning intention and key ingredients came before the practical, and an exit ticket closed the loop.
focus.dev: Sequence a full unit rather than a single lesson.

focus.title: Curriculum, assessment and reporting
focus.desc: Use curriculum, assessment and reporting knowledge to design learning sequences and lesson plans.
focus.demo: I planned from Victorian Curriculum 2.0 outcomes, including VC2TDE10D01, D04 and C03, and built the task and rubric to assess them.
focus.dev: Add reporting evidence once results are entered and reported.

focus.title: Respect for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people
focus.desc: Demonstrate broad knowledge of, understanding of and respect for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander histories, cultures and languages.
focus.dev: Draw on the 8 Ways framework in a food lesson, sourced and checked with the school.

focus.title: Literacy and numeracy strategies
focus.desc: Know and understand literacy and numeracy teaching strategies and their application in teaching areas.
focus.demo: Reading a recipe is procedural literacy; measuring, ratios and scaling a batch are numeracy. I name both for students as we work.
focus.dev: Collect student work samples from a scaling task.

focus.title: Information and communication technology
focus.desc: Implement teaching strategies for using ICT to expand curriculum learning opportunities for students.

evidence.title: Python activity files, scaffolded and extension

focus.demo: I wrote a scaffolded Python task where students complete a class method by method, with an extension for confident coders.
focus.dev: Capture student outcomes from a digital task.

3.title: Plan for and implement effective teaching and learning

focus.title: Establish challenging learning goals
focus.desc: Set learning goals that provide achievable challenges for students of varying abilities and characteristics.

evidence.title: Assessment lesson plan with success criteria

focus.demo: Success criteria were written in student voice, with extension available so the task stretched confident students.

focus.title: Plan, structure and sequence learning programs
focus.desc: Plan lesson sequences using knowledge of student learning, content and effective teaching strategies.
focus.demo: I planned and led a full lesson built on Gradual Release, from introduction through to an exit reflection.

focus.title: Use teaching strategies
focus.desc: Include a range of teaching strategies.

evidence.title: Cupcakes lesson: explicit teaching, demonstration, movement task

focus.demo: I used explicit instruction, a demonstration, questioning and a movement activity in a single period.

focus.title: Select and use resources
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge of a range of resources, including ICT, that engage students in their learning.
focus.demo: I chose and prepared the worksheets, posters and code files each lesson needed, rather than teaching from the board alone.

focus.title: Use effective classroom communication
focus.desc: Demonstrate a range of verbal and non-verbal communication strategies to support student engagement.
focus.demo: I introduced the task, decoded the question wording with students, and checked understanding before they began.
focus.dev: Gather feedback on my non-verbal habits: position in the room, wait time, gesture.

focus.title: Evaluate and improve teaching programs
focus.desc: Demonstrate broad knowledge of strategies that can be used to evaluate teaching programs to improve student learning.

evidence.title: Student reflection data analysis and revision plan

focus.demo: I analysed every student reflection sheet, grouped the gaps, and turned them into a revision plan for the next task.

focus.title: Engage parents and carers in the educative process
focus.desc: Describe a broad range of strategies for involving parents/carers in the educative process.
focus.dev: Observe how the school communicates with families and record what I learn.

4.title: Create and maintain supportive and safe learning environments

focus.title: Support student participation
focus.desc: Identify strategies to support inclusive student participation and engagement in classroom activities.
focus.demo: Pairs, defined roles and a modified worksheet meant every student had a way into the task.

focus.title: Manage classroom activities
focus.desc: Demonstrate the capacity to organise classroom activities and provide clear directions.
focus.demo: I ran the entry routine and equipment check, gave clear directions, and set up and managed assessment conditions.

focus.title: Manage challenging behaviour
focus.desc: Demonstrate knowledge of practical approaches to manage challenging behaviour.
focus.demo: I have redirected low-level behaviour and watched a restorative approach where students were given a second chance after a conversation.
focus.dev: Lead a behaviour routine myself rather than following my mentor's lead.

focus.title: Maintain student safety
focus.desc: Describe strategies that support students' wellbeing and safety working within school and/or system, curriculum and legislative requirements.
focus.demo: Safety is the content and the routine in my subject: aprons, tied hair, safe knife and oven use, and an assessment built on food safety and hygiene.

focus.title: Use ICT safely, responsibly and ethically
focus.desc: Demonstrate an understanding of the relevant issues and the strategies available to support the safe, responsible and ethical use of ICT in learning and teaching.
focus.demo: I model safe and responsible use of school systems and online sources when students research and code.

5.title: Assess, provide feedback and report on student learning

focus.title: Assess student learning
focus.desc: Demonstrate understanding of assessment strategies, including informal and formal, diagnostic, formative and summative approaches to assess student learning.
focus.demo: I planned and delivered a summative task for Year 7, and used questioning and observation as informal checks during practical lessons.

focus.title: Provide feedback to students
focus.desc: Demonstrate an understanding of the purpose of providing timely and appropriate feedback to students about their learning.

evidence.title: Review and reflection sheet with study toolbox

focus.demo: Students received a reflection sheet that named what to do next, with a toolbox of study strategies rather than a bare mark.
focus.dev: Add written feedback on a marked student task.

focus.title: Make consistent and comparable judgements
focus.desc: Demonstrate understanding of assessment moderation and its application to support consistent and comparable judgements of student learning.
focus.demo: I marked a set of tests alongside my mentor against the rubric, then compared our judgements.

focus.title: Interpret student data
focus.desc: Demonstrate the capacity to interpret student assessment data to evaluate student learning and modify teaching practice.

evidence.title: Reflection data analysis and revision plan

focus.demo: Grouping the reflections showed the gaps were food safety facts and two question formats, and that most students had studied passively. That shaped what to reteach.

focus.title: Report on student achievement
focus.desc: Demonstrate understanding of a range of strategies for reporting to students and parents/carers and the purpose of keeping accurate and reliable records of student achievement.
focus.dev: Learn how results are recorded and reported, and write an ongoing progress entry.

focus.title: Identify and plan professional learning needs
focus.desc: Demonstrate an understanding of the role of the Australian Professional Standards for Teachers in identifying professional learning needs.
focus.demo: I use the standards to set goals and to find the gaps in my own evidence, which is what this portfolio is for.

focus.title: Engage in professional learning and improve practice
focus.desc: Understand the relevant and appropriate sources of professional learning for teachers.
focus.demo: I took part in the school's curriculum planning days on the Victorian Teaching and Learning Model.

focus.title: Engage with colleagues and improve practice
focus.desc: Seek and apply constructive feedback from supervisors and teachers to improve teaching practices.
focus.demo: I ask my mentor to watch for two or three specific things each lesson, and record the feedback and my next step.

focus.title: Apply professional learning and improve student learning
focus.desc: Demonstrate an understanding of the rationale for continued professional learning and the implications for improved student learning.
focus.demo: I act on feedback in the following lesson and note what changed for students.

7.title: Engage professionally with colleagues, parents, carers and the community

focus.title: Meet professional ethics and responsibilities
focus.desc: Understand and apply the key principles described in codes of ethics and conduct for the teaching profession.
focus.demo: I keep student information confidential and work within the conduct expected by the Victorian Institute of Teaching.

focus.title: Comply with legislative, administrative and organisational requirements
focus.desc: Understand the relevant legislative, administrative and organisational policies and processes required for teachers according to school stage.

evidence.title: Placement records, child safe and safety rules

focus.demo: I follow the school's systems and requirements, including child safe standards, uniform and kitchen safety rules.

focus.title: Engage with parents and carers
focus.desc: Understand strategies for working effectively, sensitively and confidentially with parents/carers.
focus.dev: Understand the school's approach to family communication, including dietary and medical information.

focus.title: Engage with professional teaching networks and communities
focus.desc: Understand the role of external professionals and community representatives in broadening teachers' professional knowledge and practice.
focus.demo: I work with the Food and Technologies faculty at the school and with my university placement network.
